It solves the problem of "stair-stepping" or hard edges that occur when a coarse voxel grid is cut by a plane, by distributing the fill value of a voxel across its internal sub-voxel cells based on the signed distance to the clipping face.
The voxel geometry is defined by a center position, a `cellSize`, and a subdivision structure `SubVoxels` (containing `Divisions` and `CellCount`).

**Sub-Voxel Iteration:** Iterate over all sub-voxel cells indexed by $(sx, sy, sz)$ where $0 \le sx, sy, sz < Divisions$.
